'''The wreck''' was the name given to a crashed [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of unknown origin that was beneath the [[Ocean/Legends|waves]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]]. Discovered on the planet when [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] scanned the planet around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the derelict had been stripped of [[Engine/Legends|engines]], instruments, bodily remains, and any indication as to who had built or [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the vessel, leaving a hollowed out hole. The wreck became a popular tourist spot on Spira, with divers exploring the ship.

Possessed of organic-looking lines, the wreck's passages were ribbed and oddly curved. Only one safe entrance, a large break in the hull on the port side, granted entry to the derelict, and several doors had been welded shut to prevent tourists from entering unsafe areas.
